environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with full network egress, running as root user in container. PostgreSQL RDS instance with database user 'app_service' having full CRUD permissions (GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES). Java 11 runtime with commons-collections 3.2.1, spring-beans 5.3.x, and other gadget-rich libraries on classpath. No deserialization filters configured. Service exposed via NLB with no request inspection.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
